title: You are a Parrot.
description: identifier ug_parrot; archive.org video item 'You are a Parrot.' in the collection 'U.G. Krishnamurti conversations and interviews - video' (uploader Jeff Kaplan, Aug 2012); corresponds to the 10-minute 'You are a Parrot' clip on the WELL streaming archive.

title: U.G. with Dr. Larry Morris (2/2)
description: identifier ug_hillside2; second half of the Albuquerque discussion with Dr. Larry Morris and members of the Hillside Church Group (April 1992); companion to ug_hillside (1/2). The 'hillside' identifier refers to the Hillside Church Group, Albuquerque, not to Mill Valley.

title: U.G. with Dr. Larry Morris (1/2)
description: identifier ug_hillside; first half of the Albuquerque discussion with Dr. Larry Morris / Hillside Church Group, April 1992 (title corrected from earlier wave: the item is not a Mill Valley recording).

title: There is no such thing as Enlightenment.
description: identifier ug_no_enlightenment; short video clip in the U.G. video collection; title 'There is no such thing as Enlightenment.' (short-talks series alongside 'You are a Parrot', 'Spiritual Con', 'Sorrow').

title: U.G. Radio Interview (2/3)
description: identifier ug_f2f_2; audio item titled 'U.G. Radio Interview (2/3)' in ugkrishnamurti-audio; implies the series ug_f2f_1 = Radio Interview (1/3) and ug_f2f_3 = Radio Interview (3/3) (those two identifiers not yet confirmed by search).

title: U.G. on Dimensions in Parapsychology
description: identifier ug_ug_parapsy_150; video pair of the audio item ug_ug_parapsy; TV programme 'Dimensions in Parapsychology'.

title: U.G. with S.C. Birla (1/2)
description: identifier ug_birla_01; confirmed: 1989 discussion with S.C. Birla in Gstaad, filed in the video collection; part 2 (ug_birla_02) not surfaced by search but implied by the (1/2) title.

title: Bangalore conversations with Bhramchari some chants
description: identifier ug_bangalore_bramchari_chants; metadata gives 1984 (one year field reads 1982); conversations in Bangalore with Bramchari plus chants.

title: Converstaion on Radio KUNM with George Gary in Albuquerqe, New Mexico
description: identifier ug_george_gary_kunm_radio_albu; radio conversation on KUNM (University of New Mexico public radio) with George Gary, Albuquerque; title misspelled on archive.org ('Converstaion', 'Albuquerqe'). Probably from the April 1992 Albuquerque visit (same trip as ug_hillside).

title: Audio version of "U.G. on Dimensions in Parapsychology"
description: identifier ug_ug_parapsy; audio of the TV programme 'Dimensions in Parapsychology' hosted by Bryce Bond (interviewer name confirmed by search snippet); video pair ug_ug_parapsy_150.

title: Palm Reading
description: identifier ug_palm_reading; description on archive.org: U.G. Krishnamurti, 'Palm Reading', in Australia (so a Sydney-era, 1990–1994 recording).

title: U. G. Krishnamurti tapes (thisrobotdreaming blog post)
format: blog post linking to archive.org uploads
description: no archive.org identifier yet; LEAD, not an archive.org identifier: blog post at thisrobotdreaming.com says the author uploaded all their U.G. cassette tapes (1967 to the 1990s, converted to MP3) to the Internet Archive with a 'listen here' link; uploader username and item identifiers not surfaced by search.
